hooks.name: command-guard
hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$cmd" ] || exit 0; case "$cmd" in *"rm -rf"*|*"rm -fr"*|*"git reset --hard"*|*"git clean -f"*|*"git checkout --"*|*"git restore --staged"*|*"git branch -D"*|*"push --force"*|*"push -f"*|*"--force-with-lease"*|*"commit --amend"*|*"rebase -i"*|*"filter-branch"*|*"npm publish"*|*"npm unpublish"*|*"gh pr merge"*|*"gh release create"*|*"gh repo delete"*|*"node -e"*) jq -n --arg c "$cmd" '{decision:"deny",reason:("Blocked irreversible or outbound command: \($c). This is on the denylist; run it manually if it is truly intended.")}'; exit 0;; esac; case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cur=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; def=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^origin/@@'); [ -n "$def" ] || def=main; case "$cur" in "$def"|main|master) jq -n --arg b "$cur" '{decision:"deny",reason:("On default branch \($b). Create a feature branch first, then commit.")}';; esac; exit 0

hooks.name: secret-scan
hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '[.tool_input | .. | strings] | join("\n")' 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq -e '-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}' && jq -n '{decision:"deny",reason:"Possible secret in this write (private key or cloud/token pattern). Blocked; remove the secret or write it outside the repo."}'; exit 0

hooks.name: protected-file-guard
hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; b=${f##*/}; case "$b" in .env.example|.env.sample|.env.template|.env.*.example) exit 0;; esac; case "$b" in .env|.env.*|*.pem|*.key|id_rsa|id_ed25519|*.p12|*.keystore|package-lock.json|npm-shrinkwrap.json|yarn.lock|pnpm-lock.yaml|bun.lockb) jq -n --arg f "$b" '{decision:"deny",reason:("Editing protected file \($f) (secret/key/lockfile). Blocked; regenerate lockfiles via the package manager or write outside the repo.")}';; esac; exit 0

hooks.name: prettier-on-write
hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.scss|*.html|*.md|*.mdx|*.yaml|*.yml) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; npx --no-install prettier --find-config-path "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 0
